payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the pretrained word embeddings used, including Twitter-specific word vectors, emoji embeddings, and Edinburgh embeddings.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include word vectors created from a Twitter dataset.
Emoji embeddings learned from emoji descriptions were also utilized.
Edinburgh embeddings were obtained by training a skip-gram model on the Edinburgh corpus.
Edinburgh embeddings outperform GloVe embeddings in certain emotional categories.
